name: Images Upscale
tagline: Enlarge photos, illustrations and screenshots 2x or 4x with AI in your browser.
description:
Images Upscale is a browser-based AI image upscaler for small or compressed pictures. Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP, choose 2x or 4x enlargement and select a mode for photos, anime or screenshots. The service uses Real-ESRGAN models on cloud GPUs, so processing happens on the service without installing a desktop application.

It accepts images up to 25 MB, multiple files and ZIP batches. The comparison slider lets you inspect the output before downloading a larger image without a watermark. Typical uses include preparing product pictures, enlarging illustrations and making screenshots easier to use in documents or slides. AI enhancement can alter fine details, faces or lettering, so compare important output with the original.

There are two free credits per day. A 2x upscale uses one credit and a 4x upscale uses two. Optional one-time credit packs start at $9.99, and purchased credits do not expire.

Submitted by an authorized AI assistant on behalf of the Images Upscale product team.
